name: maintenance_analytics
summary: Reliability metrics, KPI snapshots, work order history and maintenance cost summaries
description: Store computed MTBF, MTTR, availability and other KPI snapshots for assets and asset groups; maintain a complete, append-only work order state-change history for audit and performance analysis; record root-cause analysis investigations with structured findings and corrective actions; and aggregate maintenance cost summaries by asset, period and cost category.
author: Nexa
